learning_outcomes.text: This course explains the fundamental principles of measurement techniques; it evaluates measurement errors, accuracy, precision, repeatability, and calibration concepts based on measurement results.

It explains the working principles of calipers, micrometers, comparators etc.; it performs dimensional measurements with these measuring instruments, determines measurement uncertainty, and interprets the results.
It explains the principles of surface roughness measurement; it calculates roughness parameters such as Ra and Rz from measuring instrument data and analyzes them in terms of production quality.
It explains the working principle and application areas of Coordinate Measuring Machines (CMMs); ??it measures and evaluates the dimensional and geometric tolerances of parts with complex geometries.

It explains methods for measuring shear force, pressure, flow rate, and temperature; it measures, calculates, and interprets shear force, pressure, fluid flow rate, and temperature values ??using appropriate sensors and measurement techniques.
